title: School Admission Process: A Complete Guide
content:
This guide walks you through the complete admission process at Minhaajulhudaa School, from application to enrollment.

## Step 1: Application
Complete the online admission form available on our website. You will need to provide student information, guardian details, and previous school records.

## Step 2: Assessment
After reviewing your application, we will invite the student for an assessment. The assessment evaluates academic readiness and Qur'an reading ability.

## Step 3: Interview
Selected students and their parents will be invited for an interview with the admission committee.

## Step 4: Admission Decision
Decisions are communicated within two weeks of the interview. Accepted students receive an admission letter with enrollment details.

## Step 5: Enrollment
Complete the enrollment by paying the required fees and submitting remaining documents.
author: Admission Office

title: Understanding Our Fee Structure
content:
A detailed breakdown of school fees and payment options.

## Tuition Fees
Tuition varies by level:
- Primary: ₦150,000 per term
- Junior Secondary: ₦180,000 per term
- Senior Secondary: ₦200,000 per term

## Additional Fees
- Registration (one-time): ₦20,000
- Uniform: ₦15,000 - ₦18,000
- Books: ₦10,000 - ₦20,000
- Sports: ₦5,000 per term
- Transportation (optional): ₦30,000 per term

## Payment Options
- Full term payment
- Installment plan (3 installments)
- Sibling discount (10% for 2nd child, 15% for 3rd+)

## Scholarships
We offer merit-based scholarships for outstanding students and need-based financial aid.
author: Finance Office

title: Our Curriculum Overview
content:
Minhaajulhudaa School offers an integrated curriculum combining the Nigerian national curriculum with comprehensive Islamic studies.

## Academic Subjects
English, Mathematics, Sciences, Social Studies, Computer Science, and Languages.

## Islamic Studies
Qur'an (recitation and memorization), Tajweed, Arabic Language, Islamic History, Fiqh, and Akhlaq.

## Extracurricular
Sports, Robotics, Debating, Arts, and Community Service.

## Assessment
Continuous assessment (40%) and termly examinations (60%).
author: Academic Office
